title: Getting started
share: New to Decibyl? Open your invitation, choose your language, ask for one real task and say "Do it" when the preview looks right. No apps to connect first. Join the free early access list at app.decibyl.ai

scenes.sub: From your invitation to your first finished task.

scenes.title: Open your invitation
scenes.sub: Sign in from the link in your invite. Early access is free, with usage limits.

ui.heading: You're invited to Decibyl
ui.sub: Priya Sharma invited you to early access.

scenes.title: Choose your language
scenes.sub: Decibyl replies and speaks in it. Confirm your time zone while you're here.

scenes.title: Ask for one real task
scenes.sub: Type it, or tap Talk and say it. No apps to connect first.

ui.name: Riya
ui.ask: Remind me to pay the electricity bill on the 5th, every month

scenes.title: Check it, then say Do it
scenes.sub: Anything that sends, books or pays waits for your OK.

ui.user: Remind me to pay the electricity bill on the 5th, every month
ui.reply: Sure. I'll remind you on the 5th of every month at 9 am, here and on WhatsApp.

approval.wants: Set a monthly reminder: pay the electricity bill
approval.detail: 5th of every month, 9:00 am · in Chat and on WhatsApp

done: Will do, every month on the 5th at 9:00.

scenes.line: Talk to Decibyl. Get everyday things done.
